text: しっかり　みきわめて　たたかおう！

structure.jp: しっかり　みきわめて

patterns.name: 〜よう (volitional)
patterns.explanation: The う-form of a verb means 'let's do it' or 'I will do it'. たたかおう = 'let's battle'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins actions in order, here 'do this, then that'. しっかり　みきわめて　たたかおう = 'size things up, then battle'.
